############################
# CTCF ChIP-seq -- revision
# To further examine the changes of CTCF binding in AD brains, we re-analyzed the published CTCF ChIP-seq data from Rush Alzheimer's Disease Center (Rush-ENCODE project).
# Using 59 PFC CTCF ChIP-seq dataset from Rush/ENCODE, we observed little change in the number of peaks or the fraction of peaks containing CTCF motifs. Differential binding analysis (DiffBind + edgeR) between AD (AD + AD&CI) and non-AD (NCI) also identified no significantly differential peaks in binding intensity.
############################
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(edgeR)
library(ggrastr)
###################
# load sample meta table
###################
anno_ctcf <- read.table(file = "data/Rush_ENCODE/CTCF_meta.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
###################
# load data 
###################
# load CTCF motif annotation
data_ctcf <- read.table(file = "data/Rush_ENCODE/CTCF_anno/CTCF_recalibrated.final.motif_occurence.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
# load signal summary
data_signal <- read.table(file = "data/Rush_ENCODE/CTCF_anno/CTCF_recalibrated.final.signal.filtered.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
# load signal differnetial 
data_signal_diff <- read.table(file = "data/Rush_ENCODE/CTCF_anno/CTCF_recalibrated.final.signal.diff.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
data_signal_diff <- merge(data_signal_diff, data_ctcf[, c("chrom", "start", "end", "group", "sample_count", "motif_count", "closest_motif_idx", "closest_motif_score", "closest_motif_age", "closest_distance")], by = c("chrom", "start", "end"), sort = F)
# load read count at peak region
data_peak_count <- read.table(file = "data/Rush_ENCODE/CTCF_anno/peak_read_count_summary.with_header.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
data_peak_sample <- read.table(file = "data/Rush_ENCODE/CTCF_DiffBind_sample.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
data_samples <- data_peak_sample[, c("SampleID", "Condition")]
data_samples$Condition <- factor(data_samples$Condition, levels = c("non_AD", "AD"))
data_counts <- data_peak_count[, 4:ncol(data_peak_count)]
data_peaks <- data_peak_count[, 1:3]
# create DE object
object_diffbind <- DGEList(counts = data_counts, samples = data_samples, genes = data_peaks)
# FRIP analysis
data_frip_all <- read.table(file = "data/Rush_ENCODE/CTCF_anno/CTCF_bulk_FRIP.all_peak.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
data_frip_sample <- read.table(file = "data/Rush_ENCODE/CTCF_anno/CTCF_bulk_FRIP.sample_peak.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t')
data_frip_all <- merge(data_frip_all, unique(anno_ctcf[, c("sample_id", "age_group", "gender", "disease_group")]), by.x = "SampleID", by.y = "sample_id", sort = F)
data_frip_sample <- merge(data_frip_sample, unique(anno_ctcf[, c("sample_id", "age_group", "gender", "disease_group")]), by.x = "SampleID", by.y = "sample_id", sort = F)
####################
# FRIP analysis
####################
data_frip_all %>%
  mutate(disease_group = factor(disease_group, levels = paste0("Cogdx_", seq(5)))) %>%
  mutate(disease_group = ifelse(disease_group == "Cogdx_1", "non-AD", "AD")) %>%
  mutate(disease_group = factor(disease_group, levels = c("non-AD", "AD"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = disease_group, y = FRiP)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.3) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("FRiP") +
  theme_cowplot()
####################
# DiffBind analysis
####################
# Keep peaks with at least 1 read in ≥3 samples (same as DiffBind default)
keep <- filterByExpr(object_diffbind, group = data_samples$Condition, min.count = 1, min.total.count = 5)
object_diffbind <- object_diffbind[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
# TMM normalization (exactly what DiffBind uses)
object_diffbind <- calcNormFactors(object_diffbind, method = "TMM")
# Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Condition, data = data_samples)
# Dispersion estimation
object_diffbind <- estimateDisp(object_diffbind, design, robust = TRUE)
# Fit GLM
fit <- glmQLFit(object_diffbind, design, robust = TRUE)
# Test Disease vs Control
qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "ConditionAD")
#
res <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table %>%
  arrange(FDR)
# plot volcano plot
panel_diffbind <- res %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR))) +
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.1), dpi = 600) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  xlab("logFC") +
  ylab("-log10(FDR)") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4,4), ylim = c(0, 4)) +
  theme_cowplot()
pdf(file = "R_notebook_figures/2025_revision/figure_CTCF_ChIP_seq_peak_diffbind.pdf", width = 5, height = 4)
print(panel_diffbind)
dev.off()

###################
# analysis - recalibration check
###################
# sample count disbution for recalicated CTCF peak
panel_ctcf_count_distr <- data_ctcf %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_count, fill = group)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0, color = "black") +
  xlab("Number of sample with peak") +
  ylab("Peak Count") +
  ggtitle("Number of peak by occurence in sample") +
  facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("original" = "#8da0cb", "recalibrated" = "#fc8d62")) +
  theme_cowplot() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  theme(axis.line.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
# percent of peak overlapping with CTCF motif
panel_ctcf_motif_fraction <- data_ctcf %>%
  mutate(overlap_motif = ifelse(motif_count > 0, 'CTCF', 'no_CTCF')) %>%
  mutate(overlap_motif = factor(overlap_motif, levels = rev(c("CTCF", "no_CTCF")))) %>%
  group_by(group, sample_count, overlap_motif) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  group_by(group, sample_count) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
  filter(overlap_motif == "CTCF") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_count, y = count/total, fill = overlap_motif)) +
  geom_col(col = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0, color = "black") +
  xlab("Number of sample with peak") +
  ylab("Fractino of peak with CTCF motif") +
  ggtitle("Fraction of peak overlapping with CTCF motif") +
  facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 1) +
  #scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("original" = "#8da0cb", "recalibrated" = "#fc8d62")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
# motif score
panel_ctcf_motif_score <- data_ctcf %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(sample_count), y = closest_motif_score, fill = group)) +
  #geom_violin(position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, position = position_dodge()) +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 11.0, color = "black") +
  xlab("Number of sample with peak") +
  ylab("CTCF motif score") +
  ggtitle("Motif score trend") +
  facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("original" = "#8da0cb", "recalibrated" = "#fc8d62")) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  annotate("segment", x=-Inf, xend=Inf, y=-Inf, yend=-Inf)
plot_grid(panel_ctcf_count_distr, panel_ctcf_motif_fraction, panel_ctcf_motif_score, ncol = 1, align = 'v', axis = 'lr')
# exploration the disease group 
data_ctcf_sample <- data_ctcf %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("ENCFF"), names_to = "file_accession", values_to = "peak_sign") %>%
  filter(peak_sign != 0)
data_ctcf_sample <- merge(data_ctcf_sample, unique(anno_ctcf[, c("file_accession", "sample_id", "age_group", "gender", "disease_group")]), by =  "file_accession", sort = F)
# exploration of the signal
data_signal <- merge(data_signal, unique(anno_ctcf[, c("sample_id", "age_group", "gender", "disease_group")]), by = "sample_id")
###################
# making plots
###################
# number of peak
panel_peak_count_by_disease_group <- data_ctcf_sample %>%
  group_by(disease_group, sample_id, gender) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%

panel_ctcf_count_by_disease_group <- data_ctcf_sample %>%
```

############################
# CTCF motifs' snATAC-seq signal -- revsion 
# Because ChIP-seq data from Rush/ENCODE are bulk tissue data, we next examined single-nucleus ATAC-seq (snATAC-seq) data from Xiong et al to investigate CTCF binding changes at cell-type resolution. 
# We compared the signals at CTCF motifs between AD and non-AD.
############################
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
# load sample meta
data_sample_meta <- read.table(file = "annotation/sample_info.v2.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
# load snATAC-seq cell meta
data_atac_cell_meta_TSS6 <- read.table(file = "/work/magroup/shared/4DN_project/ad/result_atac/snATAC_meta_TSS_6.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F, comment.char = "")
data_atac_cell_meta_TSS1 <- read.table(file = "/work/magroup/shared/4DN_project/ad/result_atac/snATAC_meta_TSS_1.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F, comment.char = "")
# sample list
sample_list = data_sample_meta$library_id
data_atac_cell_meta_TSS6_filter <- data_atac_cell_meta_TSS6 %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cellId, delim = '#', names = c("Sample", "CellID"), cols_remove = F) %>%
  filter(Sample %in% sample_list)
data_atac_cell_meta_TSS1_filter <- data_atac_cell_meta_TSS1 %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cellId, delim = '#', names = c("Sample", "CellID"), cols_remove = F) %>%
  filter(Sample %in% sample_list)
# cell-wise FRiP
data_atac_cell_meta_TSS6_filter <- merge(data_atac_cell_meta_TSS6_filter, data_sample_meta[, c("library_id", "projid", "gender", "disease_group")], by.x = "Sample", by.y = "library_id", sort = F)
data_atac_cell_meta_TSS1_filter <- merge(data_atac_cell_meta_TSS1_filter, data_sample_meta[, c("library_id", "projid", "gender", "disease_group")], by.x = "Sample", by.y = "library_id", sort = F)
# sanity check if TSS > 6 match TSS > 1
tmp <- data_atac_cell_meta_TSS6 %>%
  filter(!cellId %in% data_atac_cell_meta_TSS1$cellId) 
# load the CTCF-anchored FRiP 
data_ctcf_frip <- data.frame()
#for (filename in list.files("results/202507/ATAC_FRiP/")) {
for (filename in list.files("results/202507/ATAC_FRiP.300bp/")) {
  if (grepl(".*txt", filename)) {
    tmp_data <- read.table(paste0("results/202507/ATAC_FRiP.300bp/", filename), sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
    data_ctcf_frip <- rbind(data_ctcf_frip, tmp_data)
    cat(paste0("load ", filename, '\n'))
  }
}
#
data_ctcf_frip <- data_ctcf_frip %>%
  mutate(cellId = paste0(sample_id, '#', cell_id)) %>%
  mutate(CTCF_FRIP = FRiP)
# 
data_atac_ctcf_TSS6 <- merge(data_atac_cell_meta_TSS6_filter, data_ctcf_frip[, c("cellId", "CTCF_FRIP")], by = "cellId", all.x = T, sort = F)
data_atac_ctcf_TSS1 <- merge(data_atac_cell_meta_TSS1_filter, data_ctcf_frip[, c("cellId", "CTCF_FRIP")], by = "cellId", all.x = T, sort = F)
# load ATAC-seq signal at intergenic regions 
data_atac_intergenic <- read.table(file = "results/202507/ATAC_intergenic_signal/ATAC_intergenic_1kb_xiong_signal_sum.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, comment.char = "")
colnames(data_atac_intergenic)[1] <- "chrom"
# load bigwig signal at CTCF motif
data_ctcf_signal <- data.frame()
for (cell_type in c("Astro", "Exc", "Inh", "Micro", "Oligo", "OPC", "Endo", "VLMC")) {
  tmp_data <- read.table(paste0("results/202507/ATAC_CTCF_motif_signal/ATAC_CTCF_motif_50bp_signal_sum.", cell_type, ".tsv"), sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, comment.char = "")
  colnames(tmp_data) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "TSS1_lateAD", "TSS1_nonAD", "TSS6_lateAD", "TSS6_nonAD", "CTCF_peak", "ATAC_peak")
  tmp_data$cell_type <- cell_type
  data_ctcf_signal <- rbind(data_ctcf_signal, tmp_data)
}
###################
# plot the ATAC-seq signal at CTCF motif
###################
data_ctcf_signal_processed <- data_ctcf_signal %>%
  mutate(cell_type  = factor(cell_type, levels = c("Exc", "Inh", "Astro", "Micro", "Oligo", "OPC", "Endo", "VLMC"))) %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% c("Astro", "Exc", "Inh", "Micro", "Oligo", "OPC")) %>%
  mutate(motif_category = ifelse(CTCF_peak > 0 & ATAC_peak > 0, "CTCF(peak)-ATAC(peak)", 
                ifelse(CTCF_peak > 0 & ATAC_peak == 0, "CTCF(peak)-ATAC(nonpeak)", 
                       ifelse(CTCF_peak == 0 & ATAC_peak > 0, "CTCF(peak)-ATAC(peak)", "CTCF(peak)-ATAC(nonpeak)")))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(cell_type, chrom, start, end, motif_category, CTCF_peak, ATAC_peak), names_to = "group", values_to = "signal") %>%
  group_by(cell_type, group) %>%
  mutate(signal_rescale = signal/sum(signal)*1000000) 
data_ctcf_signal_processed_summary <- data_ctcf_signal_processed %>%
  group_by(cell_type, group, motif_category) %>%
  summarise(signal_mean = mean(signal), signal_rescale_mean = mean(signal_rescale))
panel_ctcf_signal_peak <- data_ctcf_signal_processed %>%
  filter(motif_category == "CTCF(peak)-ATAC(peak)") %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% c("Astro", "Exc", "Inh", "Micro", "Oligo", "OPC")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = log(signal_rescale+1))) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = subset(data_ctcf_signal_processed_summary, motif_category == "CTCF(peak)-ATAC(peak)"), aes(x = group, y = log(signal_rescale_mean+1)), pch = 23, size = 4, fill = "firebrick") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("log(normalized ATAC-siganl per motif +/-200bp") +
  ggtitle("CTCF motif with ATAC peak") +
  facet_wrap( ~ cell_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 30)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
panel_ctcf_signal_non_peak <- data_ctcf_signal_processed %>%
  filter(motif_category == "CTCF(peak)-ATAC(nonpeak)") %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% c("Astro", "Exc", "Inh", "Micro", "Oligo", "OPC")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = log(signal_rescale+1))) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.2) +
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)

library(ggrastr)
# load DEP from Xiong et al. Table S6
data_atac_dep_astro <- read_excel("/work/magroup/yangz6/AD_project/shared_ref_data/xiong2023/DEP/Xiong_et_al_Supp_Table_6.xlsx", sheet = "Ast.DEP")
data_atac_dep_exc <- read_excel("/work/magroup/yangz6/AD_project/shared_ref_data/xiong2023/DEP/Xiong_et_al_Supp_Table_6.xlsx", sheet = "Ex.DEP")
data_atac_dep_inh <- read_excel("/work/magroup/yangz6/AD_project/shared_ref_data/xiong2023/DEP/Xiong_et_al_Supp_Table_6.xlsx", sheet = "In.DEP")
data_atac_dep_micro <- read_excel("/work/magroup/yangz6/AD_project/shared_ref_data/xiong2023/DEP/Xiong_et_al_Supp_Table_6.xlsx", sheet = "Microglia.DEP")
data_atac_dep_oligo <- read_excel("/work/magroup/yangz6/AD_project/shared_ref_data/xiong2023/DEP/Xiong_et_al_Supp_Table_6.xlsx", sheet = "Oligo.DEP")
data_atac_dep_opc <- read_excel("/work/magroup/yangz6/AD_project/shared_ref_data/xiong2023/DEP/Xiong_et_al_Supp_Table_6.xlsx", sheet = "OPC.DEP")
# add cell_type
data_atac_dep_astro[, "cell_type"] <- "Astro"

data_atac_dep_micro[, "cell_type"] <- "Micro"

data_atac_dep_opc[, "cell_type"] <- "OPC"
# merge all data
data_atac_dep_all <- rbind(data_atac_dep_astro, data_atac_dep_exc, data_atac_dep_inh,

# save DEP
data_atac_dep_all_sig <- data_atac_dep_all %>%

  separate_wider_delim(cols = 'gene', delim = '_', names = c("chrom", "start", "end"))
write.table(subset(data_atac_dep_all_sig, cell_type == 'Astro'), file = "results/202507/ATAC_DEP/xiong_Astro_DEP.bed", sep = '\t', col.names = F, row.names = F, quote = F)  
write.table(subset(data_atac_dep_all_sig, cell_type == 'Exc'), file = "results/202507/ATAC_DEP/xiong_Exc_DEP.bed", sep = '\t', col.names = F, row.names = F, quote = F)  
write.table(subset(data_atac_dep_all_sig, cell_type == 'Inh'), file = "results/202507/ATAC_DEP/xiong_Inh_DEP.bed", sep = '\t', col.names = F, row.names = F, quote = F)  
write.table(subset(data_atac_dep_all_sig, cell_type == 'Micro'), file = "results/202507/ATAC_DEP/xiong_Micro_DEP.bed", sep = '\t', col.names = F, row.names = F, quote = F)  
write.table(subset(data_atac_dep_all_sig, cell_type == 'Oligo'), file = "results/202507/ATAC_DEP/xiong_Oligo_DEP.bed", sep = '\t', col.names = F, row.names = F, quote = F)  
write.table(subset(data_atac_dep_all_sig, cell_type == 'OPC'), file = "results/202507/ATAC_DEP/xiong_OPC_DEP.bed", sep = '\t', col.names = F, row.names = F, quote = F)

  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

print(panel_xiong_atac_dep)
```

############################
# eQTL -- gradient -- revision
# In the revision, we analyzed GTEx cis-eQTLs (restricted to variants whose effect allele matches our reference genome). Stratifying variants by fine-mapping posterior inclusion probability (PIP) and distance to the TSS。
# We then examined Hicformer predicted gradients at these loci.
############################
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(UpSetR) # for UpSet plot
# load eQTL normalized gradient
data_eqtl_gradient_gtex <- read.table(file = "shared_xinyue/gradient/eqtl_gradient_plotting_all.csv", header = T, sep = ',', stringsAsFactors = F)
# load eQTL
data_eqtl_GTEx <- read.table(file = "data/eQTL_Catelogue/DLPFC_GTRx.credible_sets.no_filter.eqtl_passed.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F) 
data_eqtl_GTEx <- data_eqtl_GTEx %>%
  mutate(label = "GTEx") %>%
  mutate(eqtl_label = paste0(variant_id, '_', gene_name))
data_eqtl_BrainSeq <- read.table(file = "data/eQTL_Catelogue/DLPFC_BrainSeq.credible_sets.no_filter.eqtl_passed.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
data_eqtl_BrainSeq <- data_eqtl_BrainSeq %>%
  mutate(label = "BrainSeq") %>%
  mutate(eqtl_label = paste0(variant_id, '_', gene_name))
data_eqtl_CommonMid <- read.table(file = "data/eQTL_Catelogue/DLPFC_CommonMid.credible_sets.no_filter.eqtl_passed.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
data_eqtl_CommonMid <- data_eqtl_CommonMid %>% 
  mutate(label = "CommonMind") %>%
  mutate(eqtl_label = paste0(variant_id, '_', gene_name))
# create UpSet plot to show the overlap of the dataset
data_eqtl_GTEx_pass <- data_eqtl_GTEx %>%
  filter(ref_allele == Allele_increase_expr) %>%
  filter(pip > 0.9) %>%
  select(variant_id, gene_id, gene_name, eqtl_label)
data_eqtl_BrainSeq_pass <- data_eqtl_BrainSeq %>%
  filter(ref_allele == Allele_increase_expr) %>%
  filter(pip > 0.9) %>%
  select(variant_id, gene_id, gene_name, eqtl_label)
data_eqtl_CommonMid_pass <- data_eqtl_CommonMid %>%
  filter(ref_allele == Allele_increase_expr) %>%
  filter(pip > 0.9) %>%
  select(variant_id, gene_id, gene_name, eqtl_label)
eqtl_list_input_pass <- list(GTEx_pass = data_eqtl_GTEx_pass$eqtl_label, BrainSeq_pass = data_eqtl_BrainSeq_pass$eqtl_label, CommonMind_pass = data_eqtl_CommonMid_pass$eqtl_label)
eqtl_list_input <- list(GTEx = data_eqtl_GTEx$eqtl_label, BrainSeq = data_eqtl_BrainSeq$eqtl_label, CommonMind = data_eqtl_CommonMid$eqtl_label)
# make the UpSet plot
pdf(file = "R_notebook_figures/2025_revision/figure_eqtl_dataset_comparision.pdf", width = 6, height = 4) 
upset(fromList(eqtl_list_input_pass), order.by = "freq", mainbar.y.label = "eQTL (pip > 0.9) count", sets.x.label = "eQTL (pip > 0.9) count")
upset(fromList(eqtl_list_input), order.by = "freq", mainbar.y.label = "eQTL count", sets.x.label = "eQTL count")
dev.off()
#######################
# plot the background density plot
panel_eQTL_GTEx_background <- data_eqtl_gradient_gtex %>%
  filter(group == "Background") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cell_type, delim = "-", names = c("cell_type", "disease_group")) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("Exc", "Inh", "Astro", "Oligo", "Micro", "OPC"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs_z)) +
  geom_density(fill = "lightgrey") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = -0.35), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, fill = "white", color="black") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  facet_wrap(cell_type ~ distance + disease_group, ncol = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.2, 2)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
panel_eQTL_GTEx_pip_group <- data_eqtl_gradient_gtex %>%
  filter(group != "Background") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cell_type, delim = "-", names = c("cell_type", "disease_group")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("pip > 0.9", "pip 0.1-0.9", "pip < 0.1"))) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("Exc", "Inh", "Astro", "Oligo", "Micro", "OPC"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs_z, y = group, color = group)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4, fill = "white", color="black") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  facet_wrap(cell_type ~ distance + disease_group, ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("pip > 0.9" = "#084594", "pip 0.1-0.9" = "#4292c6", "pip < 0.1" = "#9ecae1")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.2 ,2)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
pdf(file = "R_notebook_figures/2025_revision/figure_eqtl_finemapping_GTEx.pdf", width = 8, height = 12) 
print(panel_eQTL_GTEx_background)
print(panel_eQTL_GTEx_pip_group)
dev.off()
```

############################
# eQTL -- hicformer example -- revision
# Here, we show an example gene (ENSG00000114331) with high-confidence eQTLs (PIP > 0.9) from eQTL datasets. We visualize the Hicformer-predicted gradients at these eQTL loci across multiple cell types.
############################
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cowplot)
library(ggbreak) # for break y-axis for large gradient at TSS
# load eQTL
data_eqtl_BrainSeq <- read.table(file = "data/eQTL_Catelogue/DLPFC_BrainSeq.credible_sets.no_filter.eqtl_passed.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
data_eqtl_BrainSeq$label <- "BrainSeq"
data_eqtl_CommonMid <- read.table(file = "data/eQTL_Catelogue/DLPFC_CommonMid.credible_sets.no_filter.eqtl_passed.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
data_eqtl_CommonMid$label <- "CommonMid"
data_eqtl_GTEx <- read.table(file = "data/eQTL_Catelogue/DLPFC_GTRx.credible_sets.no_filter.eqtl_passed.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F) 
data_eqtl_GTEx$label <- "GTEx"
# merge
data_eqtl <- rbind(data_eqtl_BrainSeq, data_eqtl_CommonMid, data_eqtl_GTEx)
# load gene gradient 
data_gradient <- read.table(file = "results/202507/gene_example/eQTL_example.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
##########
# example I: ENSG00000114331
########## 
eg_gene_id = "ENSG00000114331"
eg_gene_chrom = unique(subset(data_gradient, gene_id == eg_gene_id)$chrom)
eg_gene_start = min(subset(data_gradient, gene_id == eg_gene_id)$start) 
eg_gene_end = max(subset(data_gradient, gene_id == eg_gene_id)$end) 
eg_gene_eqtl <- data_eqtl %>%
  filter(chrom == eg_gene_chrom & start >= eg_gene_start & end <= eg_gene_end)
# plot gradient
plot_gradient <- data_gradient %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cell_type, '-', names = c("cell_type", "disease_group")) %>%
  mutate(major = gsub(" .*", "", cell_type)) %>%
  filter(gene_id == eg_gene_id) %>%
  filter(gradient_type == 'zscore') %>%
  filter(gradient_label == 'seq_l2') %>%
  group_by(gene_id, chrom, start, end, bin_idx, major, disease_group, gradient_label, gradient_type) %>%
  summarise(gradient_score = mean(gradient_score)) %>%
  filter(major %in% c("Astro", "Exc", "Inh", "Micro", "Oligo", "OPC")) %>%
  #filter(major %in% c("Astro")) %>%
  mutate(is_sig = ifelse(gradient_score > 0, "sig", "non-sig")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = gradient_score)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 195356147, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 195608393, linetype = 2) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = is_sig), width = 1021024) +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0, linetype = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  ggtitle(paste0("Exmaple gene ", eg_gene_id, " range from ", eg_gene_chrom, ':', eg_gene_start, "-", eg_gene_end)) +
  facet_wrap(major + disease_group ~ ., ncol = 1, strip.position = "right") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks = c(0, 2, 4)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("sig" = "#e41a1c", "non-sig" = "#377eb8")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(eg_gene_start, eg_gene_end), ylim = c(-1,5)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))
plot_eqtl <- eg_gene_eqtl %>%
  group_by(chrom, start, gene_id, gene_name) %>%
  summarise(pip = max(pip)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = pip)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=start, xend=start, y=0, yend=pip)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(size=2, color="red", fill = alpha("orange", 0.8), alpha = 0.7, shape=21, stroke=1) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Pip score") +
  #facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 1, strip.position = "right") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0.1)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(eg_gene_start, eg_gene_end)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
pdf(file = "R_notebook_figures/2025_revision/figure_hicformer_eqtl_example_ENSG00000114331.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
plot_grid(plot_gradient, plot_eqtl, align = 'v', axis = 'lr', ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(5,1))
dev.off()
```


############################
# AD risk gene -- revision
# In the revision, we examined the chromatin interactions at AD risk genes identified from Open Targets GWAS data.
# We intersected AD risk genes from OpenTargets (GWAS association score > 0.4) with our DEG (adjusted p-value < 0.05, |log2FC| > 0.3). Using the same distance definition (short-range < 128 kb; mid-range 128 kb – 4 Mb), we quantified (i) changes in short-range interactions frequency and (ii) relative enrichment of mid-range interactions along at each locus using a sliding window approach (64 kb bins). 
############################
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
# patient list
patient_list_20 <- NULL
# load cell annotation
data_cell_anno <- read.table(file = "results/202501/cell_meta_table.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# load open target GWAS association score
data_gwas_score <- read.table(file = "results/202507/open_targets/GWAS_associated_genes_AD.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
ad_risk_gene_list = data_gwas_score$approvedSymbol
###########################
# load gene CRE annotation
###########################
```

############################
# GWAS -- gradient -- revision
# In the revision, we compared Hicformer-predicted gradients at AD GWAS loci from two large-scale GWAS studies (Jansen et al., 2019; Kunkle et al., 2019). We stratified variants by p-value (p < 5e-8; 5e-8 ≤ p < 0.05) and distance to the TSS (short-range < 128 kb; mid-range 128 kb – 4 Mb), and examined the distribution of predicted gradients at these loci across multiple cell types.
############################
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrastr)
data_gwas_gradient_jansen <- read.table(file = "shared_xinyue/gradient/GWAS_Jansenetal_2019_gradient_plotting_all.csv", header = T, sep = ',', stringsAsFactors = F)
data_gwas_gradient_kunkle <- read.table(file = "shared_xinyue/gradient/GWAS_Kunkle_Stage1_gradient_plotting_all.csv", header = T, sep = ',', stringsAsFactors = F)
# plot the background density plot
panel_gwas_jansen_background <- data_gwas_gradient_jansen %>%
  filter(group == "Background") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cell_type, delim = "-", names = c("cell_type", "disease_group")) %>%
  filter(cell_type == "Micro") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs_z)) +
  geom_density(fill = "lightgrey") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = -0.35), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, fill = "white", color="black") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  facet_wrap(cell_type ~ distance + disease_group, ncol = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.2, 2)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
panel_gwas_jansen_pval_group <- data_gwas_gradient_jansen %>%
  filter(group != "Background") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cell_type, delim = "-", names = c("cell_type", "disease_group")) %>%

  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("p < 5e-8", "5e-8 ≤ p < 0.05"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs_z, y = group, color = group)) +
  rasterise(geom_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7), dpi = 600) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4, fill = "white", color="black") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  facet_wrap(cell_type ~ distance + disease_group, ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("p < 5e-8" = "#084594","5e-8 ≤ p < 0.05" = "#9ecae1")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.2 ,2)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
```

############################
# Clinical trial - new added in the revision -- revision
# To place our findings in a clinical context, we integrated ClinicalTrials.gov and DrugBank (https://go.drugbank.com/) using an LLM-based agentic framework. 
# This workflow classifies AD trials into four clinically interpretable categories (e.g., cognitive enhancers, disease-targeted biologics) following a recent Perspective article (Landhuis. Nature 2025; PMID: 40962989) and maps targets to the Common Alzheimer's and Related Dementias Research Ontology (CADRO) mechanisms (e.g., amyloid beta, tau, synaptic plasticity). 
# This enables direct comparison between current clinical targets and the gene sets prioritized by our 3D chromatin and transcriptome analyses. 
# The script for the agentic workflow is provided at a sperate files 
############################
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
# function
split_gene_set_name <- function(long_string, max_chars = 20) {
  # Split the string into tokens at dashes (retain segments)
  tokens <- unlist(strsplit(long_string, "_", perl = TRUE))
  if (length(tokens) == 0) return("")
  current_line <- ""
  result <- character(0)
  for (token in tokens) {
    # Check if adding this token would exceed the limit
    if (nchar(current_line) + nchar(token) <= max_chars) {
      if (nchar(current_line) == 0) {
        current_line = token
      } else {
        current_line <- paste0(current_line, "_", token)
      }
    } else {
      # Replace the leading dash with "\n" if token starts with "-"
      result <- c(result, current_line)
      current_line <- token  # Start new line without the dash
    }
  }
  
  # Add the final line
  result <- c(result, current_line)
  # Combine lines with "\n"
  final_string <- paste(result, collapse = "\n")
  return(final_string)
}
# load clinical summary file
data_trial <- read.table(file = "script_custom/clinical_trial/results/AD_clinical_drug_gene_analysis.summary.tsv", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
data_deg_trial <- read.table(file = "script_custom/clinical_trial/results/AD_clinical_drug_enrichment.analysis.enrichment_results.txt", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
data_geneset_trial <- read.table(file = "script_custom/clinical_trial/results/AD_clinical_drug_enrichment.analysis_geneset.enrichment_results.txt", header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)

  arrange(method, group, -abs(cor_score)) %>%
  group_by(method, group) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(gene_set_name = split_gene_set_name(gene_set, 40))
data_geneset_trial_top_15 <- merge(data_geneset_trial, data_geneset_top_15[, c("gene_set", "method", "group", "gene_set_name")], sort = F)
```

```{r}
# fast cosine calculation
sourceCpp("src/cosine_rcpp.cpp")
x <- rnorm(1000)

cosine(x, y)
# query drug by differenetial signature
query_drug_signature <- function (query_genes, drug_info = c("cmap", "l1000"), sorted = TRUE, ngenes = 200, path = NULL, sim_method = "cosine") 
{
    gslist = gs.names = NULL
    if (is.character(drug_info)) {
        fname <- paste0(drug_info[1], "_es")
        utils::data(list = fname, package = "ccdata", envir = environment())
        drug_info <- get(fname)
        rm(list = fname)
    }
    if (!is.null(path)) {
        utils::data("gslist", "gs.names", package = "crossmeta", 
            envir = environment())
        path_num <- names(gs.names)[gs.names == path]
        path_sym <- unique(names(gslist[[path_num]]))
        drug_info <- drug_info[row.names(drug_info) %in% path_sym, 
            ]
    }
    query_genes <- query_genes[names(query_genes) %in% row.names(drug_info)]
    top_ngenes <- utils::head(names(sort(abs(query_genes), TRUE)), 
        ngenes)
    query_genes <- query_genes[top_ngenes]
    drug_info <- drug_info[names(query_genes), , drop = FALSE]
    if (sim_method == "pearson") {
      sim <- stats::cor(query_genes, drug_info, method = "pearson")
      sim <- structure(c(sim), names = colnames(sim))
    } else if (sim_method == "cosine") {
      sim <- lsa::cosine(query_genes, drug_info)
    } else {
      cat(paste0("Unknown method ", sim_method, '\n'))
      return(0)
    }
    if (sorted) {
        return(sort(sim, decreasing = TRUE))
    }
    else {
        return(sim)
    }
}
# 
top_gene = 200
data_single_drug_effect <- data.frame()
for (database in c("cmap", "l1000")) {
  for (cell_type_name in c("Astro", "Endo", "Exc", "Inh", "Micro", "Oligo", "OPC", "VLMC")) {
    tmp <-  data_deg %>%
      filter(gene_name %in% data_gene_set_top_k_merged_gene_list_clean) %>%
      filter(cell_type == cell_type_name) %>%
      filter(abs(log2FC) > cutoff_log2FC) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_gene)
    if (nrow(tmp) < 1) {
      next
    }
    tmp_gene_sig <- tmp$log2FC
    names(tmp_gene_sig) <- tmp$gene_name
    if (database == "cmap") {
      tmp_res <- query_drug_signature(tmp_gene_sig, cmap_es, sorted = T, ngenes = top_gene, sim_method = "cosine")
      gene_count =  length(tmp_gene_sig[names(tmp_gene_sig) %in% row.names(cmap_es)])
    } else if (database == 'l1000') {
      tmp_res <- query_drug_signature(tmp_gene_sig, l1000_es, sorted = T, ngenes = top_gene, sim_method = "cosine")
      gene_count =  length(tmp_gene_sig[names(tmp_gene_sig) %in% row.names(l1000_es)])
    }
    if (length(tmp_res) < 1) {
      next
    }
    tmp_res <- data.frame(sim = tmp_res, drug = names(tmp_res))
    tmp_res$cell_type <- cell_type_name
    tmp_res$database <- database
    tmp_res$gene_count <- gene_count
    data_single_drug_effect <- rbind(data_single_drug_effect, tmp_res)
    cat(paste0("Query ", cell_type_name, " in ", database, " done.", '\n'))
  }
}
# 
data_single_drug_effect_top_hit <- data_single_drug_effect %>%
  filter(sim < 0) %>%
  group_by(database, cell_type) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 100) %>%
  group_by(database, cell_type) %>%
  arrange(sim, .by_group = TRUE)
# add FDR
set.seed(202510)
data_single_drug_effect_fdr <- data.frame()
for (row_idx in seq(nrow(data_single_drug_effect_top_hit))) {
  drug_name = unlist(data_single_drug_effect_top_hit[row_idx, "drug"])
  cell_type_name = unlist(data_single_drug_effect_top_hit[row_idx, "cell_type"])
  database_name = unlist(data_single_drug_effect_top_hit[row_idx, "database"])
  sim_obv = unlist(data_single_drug_effect_top_hit[row_idx, "sim"])
  gene_count_drug = unlist(data_single_drug_effect_top_hit[row_idx, "gene_count"])
  # get the gene list
  tmp <-  data_deg %>%
      filter(gene_name %in% data_gene_set_top_k_merged_gene_list_clean) %>%
      filter(cell_type == cell_type_name) %>%
      filter(abs(log2FC) > cutoff_log2FC) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_gene)
  tmp_gene_sig <- tmp$log2FC
  names(tmp_gene_sig) <- tmp$gene_name
  # get the expected sim list using permutation
  if (database_name == "cmap") {
    tmp_gene_sig = tmp_gene_sig[names(tmp_gene_sig) %in% row.names(cmap_es)]
    drug_sig = cmap_es[names(tmp_gene_sig), drug_name]
  } else if (database_name == 'l1000') {
    tmp_gene_sig = tmp_gene_sig[names(tmp_gene_sig) %in% row.names(l1000_es)]
    drug_sig = l1000_es[names(tmp_gene_sig), drug_name]
  }
  sim_bg_list <- c()
  for (idx in seq(1, 400)) {
    # get permutated gene sig
    tmp_gene_permut_sig <- tmp_gene_sig
    tmp_gene_permut_sig <- sample(tmp_gene_permut_sig)
    names(tmp_gene_permut_sig) <- names(tmp_gene_sig)
    # calculate cosine sim
    sim_score = fast_cosine(tmp_gene_permut_sig, drug_sig)
    sim_bg_list <- c(sim_bg_list, sim_score)
  }
  # empirically FDR
  fdr = sum(sim_bg_list < sim_obv)/length(sim_bg_list)
  tmp <- data.frame(drug = drug_name, cell_type = cell_type_name, database = database_name, gene_count = gene_count_drug, sim = sim_obv, fdr = fdr)
  # 
  data_single_drug_effect_fdr <- rbind(data_single_drug_effect_fdr, tmp)
  #cat(paste0("Row ", row_idx, " done.", '\n'))
}

    .combine = rbind,
    .packages = c("dplyr")
  ) %:%
  foreach(
    cell_type_name = cell_type_list,
    .combine = rbind,
    .packages = c("dplyr")
  ) %dopar% {
    
    tmp <- data_deg %>%
      filter(gene_name %in% data_gene_set_top_k_merged_gene_list_clean) %>%
      filter(cell_type == cell_type_name) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_gene)
    
    if (nrow(tmp) < 1) return(NULL)
    
    tmp_gene_sig <- tmp$log2FC
    # permute tmp_gene_sig
    tmp_gene_sig <- sample(tmp_gene_sig)
    names(tmp_gene_sig) <- tmp$gene_name
    
    if (database == "cmap") {
      tmp_res <- query_drug_signature(tmp_gene_sig, database, sorted = T, ngenes = top_gene, sim_method = "cosine")
    } else if (database == 'l1000') {
      tmp_res <- query_drug_signature(tmp_gene_sig, database, sorted = T, ngenes = top_gene, sim_method = "cosine")
    }
    
    if (length(tmp_res) < 1) return(NULL)
    
    tmp_res <- data.frame(sim = tmp_res, drug = names(tmp_res))
    tmp_res$cell_type <- cell_type_name
    tmp_res$database <- database
    tmp_res$gene_count <- length(tmp_gene_sig)
    tmp_res$permute_idx <- permute_idx
    # 
    cat(paste0("Permution ", permute_idx, " in ", cell_type_name, " using ", database, " done", '\n'), file = log_file, append = TRUE)
    #
    tmp_res
  }
# Stop cluster
stopCluster(cl)

```
